description: This file implements the JSON-RPC interface for the PersistentStore component, including registration of RPC endpoints, handling of data storage operations such as set, get, delete, and namespace management, and interaction with underlying storage and cache components.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: A class providing JSON-RPC endpoints for persistent key-value storage operations, including registration, unregistration, and various data management functions.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints related to persistent storage operations.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all previously registered RPC endpoints.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the persistent store with optional TTL.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves storage size per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets the storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets the storage limit for a namespace.
